title: Battle of Bautzen (1813)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Bautzen (1813)", at revision 1379028785, opens: "In the Battle of Bautzen, a combined Prusso-Russian army, retreating after their defeat at Lützen and massively outnumbered, was pushed back by Napoleon but escaped destruction. Some sources claim that Marshal Michel Ney failed to block their retreat. The Prussians were led by General Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, and the Russians by General Peter Wittgenstein." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q170265, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1813 battle during the War of the Sixth Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
